meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把你过去留下的观测记录按主题整理成知识库,再把知识库载入对话,回答基于这些内容的问题;也能列出、重建或刷新已有知识库。
howto.when: 当你想从自己的历史记录里挑出某个主题建立专属知识库,或询问过去的工作模式、整理某领域的经验时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个关于 hooks 生命周期的知识库
say.note: Claude 会按该主题筛选记录并建好语料库。

say.text: 在这个知识库里,5 个生命周期钩子各在何时触发?
say.note: Claude 会基于该语料库的上下文作答。

say.text: 列出我现在有哪些知识库
say.note: Claude 会显示语料库列表及加载状态。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can organize your past observation records into focused knowledge bases, load one into a conversation, and answer questions from that context. It can also list, rebuild, or refresh existing corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users want to create focused brains from their observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge base about the hooks lifecycle for me.
say_en.note: Claude builds the corpus from matching observations.

say_en.text: In this knowledge base, when does each of the 5 lifecycle hooks fire?
say_en.note: Claude answers from the primed corpus context.

say_en.text: List the knowledge bases I have right now.
say_en.note: Claude shows the corpora and their priming status.
